instruction: Please set a gray background for all slides in my presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing background color to gray (RGB: 128, 128, 128) on all 19 slides. Uses existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance function to verify RGB distance from target color. Original background is white (RGB: 255, 255, 255).

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Metric iterates through ALL slides in the presentation, verifying each slide's background color
Correct state extraction: get_vm_file successfully retrieves the modified PPTX file; evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance correctly extracts background fill color from each slide
Appropriate comparison logic: Uses RGB Euclidean distance normalized by maximum possible distance, providing continuous scoring from 0 to 1
Handles multiple fill types: Correctly handles both direct slide fill (type==1) and master slide fill (type==5)
Semantically correct expected values: Gray RGB(128,128,128) accurately represents gray color; original RGB(255,255,255) correctly represents white
Proper partial credit: Scores proportionally based on how many slides are changed and how close they are to target gray
No state accessibility issues: Postconfig saves file before evaluation; file getter and metric can access needed state
